question:
In the adjoining figure line l is parallel to line m. What is the value of (x + 2y) ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/905c2a270ecc9e29bc4cc0942201541f2d5e6ffded406685ccf504d4f877d95c.png]
solution:
**Given:**

Line l is parallel to line m .

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b28a07a7c0087fab618b871f9d4ad31c8ce40440e1cfa3b73371bf592d74e16.png] 

angleQSm + angleQSR = 180° ------( Straight angle)

105° + angleQSR = 180°

angleQSR = 75°

angleQSR = anglex = 75° -------(Alternate angles)

angleAPQ + angleQPR = 180° -------(Alternate angles)

60° + angleQPR = 180°

angleQPR = 120°

angleQPR = angley = 120° ------(Alternate angle)

⇒ x + 2y = 75° + 2(120°) 

⇒315 

**The correct answer is Option 4.**
